title: Standard Occupancy of a Room on the Hotel Rate Plans That Include Breakfast
content:
How many adults a Hotel Rate Plans room is taken to hold as standard turns on whether the rate plan booked includes breakfast and on how many rooms the prepayment lines posted on the reservation cover.

## The rule

1. Where the rate plan booked includes breakfast and the prepayment lines posted on the reservation cover more than one room, the standard occupancy is 2 adults a room.
2. Where the rate plan booked includes breakfast and the prepayment lines posted cover one room, the standard occupancy is 3 adults a room.
3. Where the rate plan booked does not include breakfast, the standard occupancy is 3 adults a room.

The rooms the prepayment lines cover are the highest room sequence those lines carry on the folio. More than one room means 2 or more.

## Which plans include breakfast

| Rate plan | Breakfast included |
| --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no |
| Standard Flexible Rate | yes |
| Member Flex Rate | yes |
| Suite Flexible Rate | yes |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes |

## The combinations

| Plan includes breakfast | Rooms the prepayment lines cover | Standard occupancy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 2 or more | 2 adults a room |
| yes | 1 | 3 adults a room |
| no | 2 or more | 3 adults a room |
| no | 1 | 3 adults a room |

Only the first row departs from 3 adults a room.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A reservation on the Member Flex Rate, which includes breakfast, holding 2 rooms, with prepayment lines posted for a highest room sequence of 2. The lines cover more than one room, so the standard occupancy is 2 adults a room, and 2 rooms at that occupancy come to 4 adults.

On the Semi-Flexible Rate, which does not include breakfast, the same 2 rooms stand at 3 adults a room, coming to 6 adults.
